nominee.shortDescription: Some characters steal the spotlight. This one streams it. She even has a song made about her.
nominee.longerDescription: Happy WW! This week I am nominating Cinna, the streamer. I first saw her in this TikTok edit back like a few months ago which also features the song made about her: [https://tinyurl.com/3br8zep2]. I was intrigued cause she looks bomb AF in this edit but for some reason I didn't look her up till now. I was watching a workout + car meet video of Sara Saffari and she is known for play flirting with Cinna (and everyone else). She seemed really funny in that video so I decided to look up some of her videos and she seems like a really cool and interesting person. Now every video I see, my jaw is always on the floor cause bro she is fine AF! I was a bit turned off that she tried working out and filmed the whole process and then didn't stick with it but I can look past this cause the rest of the package is well compensating :P. In case you were wondering she is half-black, a quarter japanese and a quarter white. Interestingly I thought she has much more Japanese in her but それなら変えられるよ🇯🇵(I can change that). I always wanted to attend a GymShark event so I can meet a bunch of fitness influencers but knowing that she goes there sometimes too (cover pic) makes it even more interesting! I honestly do not understand how she looks so fucking good with all hairstyles... Overall she is getting a Hype:9.5/10, not sure if its possible to be more hyped but just in case I am going to reserve the last 0.5.
